<div class="callout-note" role="note">
<p>The Roadmap was decommissioned in June 2026.</p>
</div>
<h2>Changes to service modernisation across government</h2>
<p>The second version of the Service Modernisation Roadmap was published in November 2025. Since then, Cabinet has approved the Digital Government Target State.</p>
<p>The Target State sets the All-of-Government direction for digital that includes:</p>
<ul>
<li>digital strategy</li>
<li>architecture</li>
<li>investment</li>
<li>procurement</li>
<li>service delivery.</li>
</ul>
<p>AI will become increasingly important in all aspects of Target State delivery.</p>
<p>To deliver the Target State, the Government Digital Delivery Agency (GDDA) is working with government departments on a 3-year work programme to establish and develop Target State foundations.</p>
<p>With the public service now focused on the Digital Government Target State, the Service Modernisation Roadmap is no longer needed.</p>
<p>Modernising the government’s digital services will continue through the Digital Government Target State work.</p>
<p><a href="https://www.digital.govt.nz/digital-government/digitising-government-programme-dgp/digital-target-state">Digital Government Target State</a></p>
<h2>What the Service Modernisation Roadmap achieved</h2>
<p>The purpose of the Service Modernisation Roadmap was to show the public service’s work to progress towards a better, more unified service experience for New Zealanders.</p>
<p>The second Roadmap built on the successes of the first and focused on delivering the Government Chief Digital Officer’s (GCDO) priorities for service modernisation:</p>
<ul>
<li>Building the digital identity ecosystem</li>
<li>Developing an All-of-Government app</li>
<li>A new approach to back-office transformation</li>
<li>A new approach to digitising government.</li>
</ul>
<p>Across both versions, government agencies laid key customer-facing and technical foundations and improved alignment of digital investment. Almost all initiatives delivered, or are expected to deliver, value beyond the agencies leading the work.</p>
<p>The Roadmap also helped agencies learn from each other, build on successful work and collaborate on shared priorities.</p>
<p><a href="https://www.digital.govt.nz/digital-government/strategy/strategy-summary/decommissioned-service-modernisation-roadmap">View Decommissioned Service Modernisation Roadmap</a></p>
